short_cite: Landa 1980 USGS Circ. 814 uranium mill tailings
full_citation: Landa E.R. (1980). Isolation of Uranium Mill Tailings and Their Component Radionuclides from the Biosphere: Some Earth Science Perspectives. U.S. Geological Survey Circular 814. U.S. Geological Survey, Reston VA.
notes: Read in full text by the producer (web fetch). Used for the mill mass balance: tailings retain about 85 % of the radioactivity originally associated with the ore; more than 98 % of the Ra-226 stays with the tailings (Moffett 1976, cited); about 90-95 % of the uranium in the ore is extracted; acid-leach milling may dissolve 30-90 % of the thorium; the slime fraction (25-27 % by weight) holds 77-94 % of the Ra. Pre-1980 US mills only; modern alkaline-leach and ISL circuits not covered.
